editorial.blurb: Thali Corner serves generous, freshly made Indian thalis with generous portions and attentive service that keep diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the combo thali for 2—it arrives loaded with 4 curries, 3 vegetable dishes, daal, yogurt, rice, and roti, giving you a full buffet spread. The kitchen is open late, so you can catch fresh food even at 10:30 PM.
